evidence: Applied the quality-checks.md §5 procedure. Case-insensitive grep of task/instruction.md, environment/instructions/*.md and environment/assets/seed_data.json for judge|rubric|criteri|dimension|reward|weight|score|playwright|claude|glm|/tests|sentinel|probe|gate|grader|grade|verif|checker|harbor|oracle|polish|visual|functional|likert|restart_app|restart_mcp|test.sh|openrouter|evaluat|assess|benchmark|pass|CHANGE_ME|TODO|{{ returned zero hits. No criterion id (all 'hro_*' ids from tests/scored/*/judge.toml and gates) appears in the agent-visible text (grep 'hro_' zero hits; a looser match on stripped ids only hit ordinary words such as reopen/notes/seen/drafts/activity/restart). Grader tokens found in tests (APP_RESTART_HELPER in functional/judge.toml:18, EXERCISED in gates/constraints/prompt.md:11, MCP server names 'playwright'/'verifier') do not appear in the brief or notes. Verbatim overlap: tokenised brief+notes vs all judge.toml, prompt.md and app_context.md text shows zero shared runs of 8+ words and only three 7-word runs, all ordinary product phrases restating public requirements ('the card was changed and by whom' from hireops_rules.md:80-81; 'its most recent 30 messages oldest of' and '30 at a time in order and' from hireops_rules.md:149-150). The template placeholders (CHANGE_ME) are replaced. Lessons file check: lesson 5's self-test line exists at instruction.md:13 ('Before you hand it over, please check it yourself the way we'll use it...') and is phrased as the requester's own use, without naming a judge, browser automation or tests; lesson 12 (do not tell the builder how to build something just so the grader can test it) was checked for this row: the 401/403/404/409 codes and 'every card carries a version' (hireops_rules.md:22-24, 78-80) are given as product/API behaviour with a reason (several people working one board), not as grader hooks; hireops_rules.md §8 (lines 204-208, runtime launches from another cwd, unprivileged user, writable copy, launch env vars) describes the deployment runtime without naming the verifier, test paths or tooling, and integration.md:15-19 likewise. Lessons 13/7/8/9/14-16 concern judge prompts and do not bear on agent-visible text. Broken-app attempt: with no sentinel, probe literal, criterion id or grader route in the brief, a model cannot special-case the grader from the instructions; the only exact strings it is given (accounts, password Hireops!2026, candidate wording, page size 30, 15 seconds) are public product requirements. Conforming-alternative attempt: nothing in the brief commits the builder to grader-specific ids/labels (hireops_rules.md:3-5 says routes, field names, element ids and labels are up to the builder), so no conforming app is pushed toward or away from grader hooks by this row. This row is a static text check; no runtime evidence is required and none is claimed.
